name: CVF Governance Worker-Return Review
purpose: Guide Local reviewer assessment of internal worker returns, reviewer-local repair routing, and evidence-supported bounded closure.
useWhen: A Local reviewer has an internal worker return and must decide findings, repair route, and closure evidence within an active governed assignment.
doNotUseWhen: External Web research, initial worker execution, ordinary code-quality review without CVF return, or an unapproved runtime activation.
riskTriggers: scope or effect expansion requires the governing authority route before action
outputs: reviewer-local repair, REWORK, or stop disposition
executionConstraints: read the current canonical owners; do not infer authority from package loading; do not rerun valid worker evidence without a named contradiction and cost reason
authorityCeiling: advisory review guidance under the current governed assignment; no independent mutation or commit grant
sideEffects: none from skill loading; any reviewer edit or commit needs separate current authority
permissions: read current governed sources and returned evidence within the active assignment
rollback: revert only this proposed package, registry entry, and regenerated index/inventory if rejected
safeStop: state the exact missing authority or evidence and stop the dependent review or dispatch action
capabilityBoundary: ACTIVE in bounded CVF package executor and CLI/MCP envelope; no host installation or independent action authority
resolverBehavior: metadata-only until explicit receipt-backed ACTIVE package selection; no automatic invocation
loaderBoundary: loading metadata never grants reviewer mutation, commit, provider, public, production, or external action authority
externalMutationBoundary: no external mutation permitted from this package
shellAssumptions: commands follow the current workspace and canonical checker instructions
